hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: View all your partner balances in one place and transfer points easily with plain-English explanations.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Holding reward balances across three different partner programmes without a unified overview.
hypotheses.storyTension: Difficulty understanding how and where points can be moved without encountering confusing technical terms.
hypotheses.customerResolution: A clear, unified view of rewards with straightforward transfer comparisons free of jargon.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Effortless cross-programme reward portability visibility and plain-language transfer clarity.
completionSignals: Customer interacts with partner transfer comparison

hypotheses.oneSentenceStory: Track your progress towards your Family Holiday Fund using your combined reward balances.
hypotheses.customerSituation: Actively saving towards a Family Holiday Fund with 1750 out of 3000 points achieved.
hypotheses.storyTension: Uncertainty on how combined partner balances contribute directly to the active savings goal.
hypotheses.customerResolution: Direct alignment of unified reward balances toward the Family Holiday Fund goal.
hypotheses.primaryOutcome: Clear progress visibility toward the active savings goal.
